scientific_integrity: Exact perturbative and inductive proof; rational witness values independently evaluated and a truncated Fourier–Galerkin calculation used only as corroboration. Prior general homogenization and mean-first-passage formulas credited. Originality remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: For each finite harmonic number and its prescribed finite sign witnesses, an amplitude exists; no explicit universal amplitude bound, exact crossing count, maximal number for fixed spectral support, or genericity theorem is claimed.
title: Arbitrarily many diffusion enhancement–suppression reversals in telegraph-switched smooth periodic potentials
